limitations: The completed review journey uses the deterministic mock provider and temporary local SQLite through a bounded worker/test drain. It does not claim real-model quality, deployed worker composition, production database behavior, or live CMS integration.

Staleness is calculated only from the supplied last-updated and assessment timestamps. Keyword coverage is bounded lexical evidence, not a search-ranking measurement, and supplied product metadata is not independently verified.

The HTTP POST proves durable asynchronous intake only. The default API composition exposes discovery but returns 503 for POST until the existing manual admission service is injected; later delivery requirements own long-running process composition.

The browser gate uses the production Vite build with deterministic same-origin discovery and receipt fixtures plus the real local session endpoint. It proves the control surface and transport boundary, not live browser-observed worker completion.

The canonical URL is validated as HTTPS provenance and never fetched. The artifact is advisory only; it does not crawl, query a search engine, update or upload to a CMS, publish, approve, create an external action, or establish SEO outcomes.
Determinism covers normalized business payloads. Durable identities and timestamps remain intentionally unique or clock-derived, and DEMO-03 through DEMO-06 remain separately owned.
